description: Single source of truth for confirmed game/research figures that also appear in the design docs. scripts/project_facts.py checks that every matched figure in a target doc equals the pinned value here, so a number in prose can't silently drift from the oracle-confirmed finding. Add a fact as: id, value (the exact text as it appears, e.g. "25,000"), note, source, targets (paths under docs/), and patterns (regexes capturing the number in group 1; may span line wraps via \s+). Each fact must match at least once across its targets, so a reworded doc that drops the figure fails loudly rather than leaving a dead pin. See docs/adr and the aurora-lint check_project_facts.py this is modeled on.
